selection_rule: SHA256 order of ficus-fresh-v1:<task>; CPU-oriented lv1 repos astropy,seaborn,sympy,sphinx,pandas,xarray in already downloaded pinned snapshot; no ranking by model outcomes
stop_policy: No steering or prompt tuning; preserve all failed and interrupted attempts. Stop on accounting cap or invalid grading. Incomplete four-arm results are not a matched comparison.
runtime_policy: Reuse verified scope-overlay runtime to avoid unrelated production drift; experimental local-delivery support remains unchanged.
budget_authorization: User raised cumulative cap from $20 to $50 before fresh-task inference.
preflight_policy: Audit each repository layout; require unchanged-grader negative/positive and collision controls before inference. Preserve infrastructure failures, do not replace failed tasks. If a task cannot be validly graded, report it as blocked and continue preflight on remaining selected tasks. One image at a time; stop image operations below 10 GiB free.
